title: 'Grand Blue' Fourth Season in Production
content: • The 12th and final episode of Grand Blue Season 3 ( Grand Blue Dreaming Season 3 ) ended with an announcement on Tuesday that a fourth season is in production. The official website also revealed an announcement visual (pictured). Produced by Zero-G , the first season aired in 12 episodes in Summer 2018.

title: New Attack on Titan Trailer Reveals Disappointing Return in Fall 2026 – Watch Now
content: It’s been a while since Attack on Titan wrapped up the story in both anime and manga, but its popularity only continues to increase. Based on a manga written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the anime became a global phenomenon after its debut in 2013 thanks to its unique story and layers of mysteries.

title: 1st 2 Lufia SNES RPGs Get Collection in 2027

title: Crunchyroll’s Acclaimed Fantasy Creator Returns With New Look For Final Release
content: Yona of the Dawn concluded its main story in December last year, but the release of the final volume was delayed due to the side stories. Written and illustrated by Kusanagi Mizuho, the manga began serialization in Hakusensha’s Hana to Yume magazine in 2009.

title: Remow Launches 'It's Anime' Free Ad-Supported Channel on Live TV on PS5, Pluto TV, Prime Video
content: Anime distributor REMOW announced on Monday that it has launched the "It's Anime" free ad-supported streaming television channel (FAST) channel on Pluto TV on September 10, Amazon 's Prime Video on September 1, and PlayStation 5's Live TV on PS5 on August 31 in the U.S.
